description: Ministry of Public Administration - Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountants Service
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountants Service, detailing service qualifications, promotion criteria, and performance appraisal requirements for public service officers. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals specifically with public sector service conditions, recruitment, and career progression, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
